summary: Geopolitical alerts that can move oil. Scans every 10 minutes in the morning, every 5 minutes from noon to 10:00 pm, every 10 minutes late evening and every hour overnight (2:00 am to 8:00 am Singapore time) on weekdays, and every 3 hours from Saturday 3:00 am to Monday 3:00 am Singapore time. Counts and the net read cover the rolling last 24 hours; the feed lists all stored alerts.

netRead.bottom: Russian refinery strike claims, Hormuz tanker fires and Houthi attacks on Saudi lean higher, though Aramco's deep Asia price cut signals soft demand.
netRead.lead: Net read (last 24 hours): Russian refinery strike claims, Hormuz tanker fires and Houthi attacks on Saudi lean higher, though Aramco's deep Asia price cut signals soft demand.

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Ukrainian drones reportedly hit the Afipsky oil refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Krai (about 7 million tonnes a year); fires and explosions reported in Krasnodar
alerts.source: LetsArmUKR and several OSINT accounts (Ukrainian OSINT; no official confirmation yet)

alerts.headline: Saudi Aramco cuts December Arab Light OSP to Asia to a $7/bbl discount, about $2 lower across Asia grades
Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claims a drone strike on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam disrupted air traffic; no immediate Saudi confirmation
Saudi Civil Defense issues a second early-warning in Sharurah (Najran/Yemen border); danger passed about six minutes later, no impact disclosed
Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted and destroyed a drone over Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province
Iran Navy says two more oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the eastern Strait of Hormuz, after defying warnings; reports put it at five tankers and a tug hit today
alerts.source: First Squawk citing Iran Navy; MenchOsint; CGTN Europe

alerts.headline: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree denies Medina intercept claim; says operations target only Saudi oil facilities and military bases
Oman and Iran discuss efforts to resume navigation in the Strait of Hormuz (ONA)
Saudi Civil Defense sounds early-warning alert in Yanbu (Red Sea oil export and refining hub); no impact disclosed yet
alerts.source: First Squawk citing Saudi Civil Defense; Al Jazeera Breaking / Asharq Al-Awsat

alerts.eventTime: 4 Nov (est., UKMTO report date; clock not stated)
alerts.headline: UKMTO 196-26: tanker struck by two unidentified projectiles 50 nm north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar, in the Central Arabian Gulf; crew and damage unconfirmed
alerts.source: UKMTO via Live Squawk; AMK Mapping

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense sounds early-warning alert in Sharurah (Najran province, Yemen border), then declares danger passed about 9 minutes later; no impact disclosed
alerts.source: Saudi Civil Defense (official); Osint613; First Squawk; Arab News

alerts.headline: IRGC Navy says a large tanker hit a mine and caught fire in Hormuz's southern passage, a second supertanker and a tug also caught fire; it also claims two US Lucas drones seized
alerts.source: LiveSquawk citing IRGC statement; also Iran International

alerts.headline: WSJ: Houthis demand $51 billion from Saudi Arabia to end hostilities after Riyadh asked what price would halt Red Sea tanker attacks
Ukrainian drones hit industrial zone of Russia's Ryazan oil refinery; fires and explosions reported
alerts.source: First Squawk citing WSN; footage from multiple OSINT accounts

alerts.headline: i24 News: Israel on high security alert amid worries of a possible Iranian strike
Equinor halts oil and gas output at Norway's Visund platform after an electrical-system fire; 70 evacuated, gas exports cut to zero, restart unclear
FT: Trump's diesel deal with Russia falters as tankers with Russian diesel veer off course (one diverted to Brazil), while US distillate stocks sit at a 20-year low
alerts.source: FT Energy; tanker tracking by Russian Oil & Gas Monitor

alerts.headline: Al-Jadeed, citing Arab diplomatic sources: US-Iran negotiations have made significant progress and their course will become clearer on Friday
Al-Jadeed, citing US diplomatic sources: Trump may decide on war with Iran before the new Democratic Congress takes office

US Treasury (OFAC) issues new Iran sanctions on a false-flag ship registry network and an alert on the Iranian shadow fleet's use of false flags; secondary-sanctions risk added to many listed tankers.
Israel's Channel 14: Netanyahu convenes emergency security meeting on Iran with top military chiefs; Israel reportedly expects Trump to back a new large strike, likely on energy sites.
Senate Democratic leader Schumer, after Democrats won Congress: 'We will end the war' with Iran, says some Republicans have joined.
Brent crude falls below $100 for the first time since Oct 7; market prices a lower chance of a new US attack on Iran after the midterm rout.
EIA: US diesel (distillate) stocks fall below 100M bbl, lowest since 2003, after a 3.6M bbl weekly draw.
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing US EIA weekly data; also LiveSquawk

alerts.headline: IRGC says its air defences destroyed a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, its 15th MQ-1 claim.
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing Iranian state media / IRGC; also CGTN, FinancialJuice

alerts.headline: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claims a ballistic missile hit Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, causing major damage; urges airlines to avoid it.
alerts.source: Yahya Saree (Houthi military spokesman, Arabic); First Squawk

alerts.headline: TankerTrackers: Iran's Hormuz authority doubled its 'non-compliant' tanker target list to 240 ships; about 30% of cargo on listed tankers is Iraqi crude.
Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei says Hormuz action was a response to US 'aggression' and warns further US attacks will bring a 'far wider' response.
alerts.source: First Squawk; Iran International, Al Arabiya, Al Mayadeen

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense sounds early-warning alert in Jazan, home to Aramco's 400,000 b/d Jazan refinery, over a possible threat; danger declared passed minutes later.
alerts.source: Open Source Intel (citing Saudi Civil Defense); Iran International

alerts.headline: Aramco CEO says work has begun to expand the East-West Pipeline that bypasses Hormuz; engineering underway on other export routes and more storage abroad (per Reuters).
Saudi Civil Defense sounds early-warning alert in Najran province near the Yemen border, then declares danger passed minutes later; unverified reports of explosions.
Trump tells Politico he is again open to striking Iran: 'if we see any opportunity to do one thing or another, we're going to do it'
Iran International: Iran enlists China and Russia in Hormuz talks with US; mediators weigh China guaranteeing US sanctions relief for nuclear concessions.
IRGC now says four tankers destroyed by naval mines south of the Strait of Hormuz and still burning; two more vessels detained.
alerts.source: FirstSquawk / RedboxWire / LiveSquawk citing IRGC (Sepah News)

alerts.headline: WSJ: Iran escalating Hormuz ship attacks with underwater drones and limpet mines; Kpler says flows last week averaged 7.8M bpd, about 45% of prewar, after 35+ October incidents.
Saudi Civil Defense issues early-warning alert for Riyadh as ballistic missiles reportedly launched from Yemen; all-clear about 10 minutes later, no damage reported.
Trump tells the FT the US has no immediate plan to strike Iran, calling the standoff 'brilliant' and saying 'we're not really in a war'.
UKMTO 195-26: tanker struck by two unknown projectiles in engine room 14 nm NE of Lima, Oman, in the southern Strait of Hormuz corridor; no casualties.
NYT: Pentagon readying options for a renewed major US attack on Iran, possibly as early as Nov 4, right after the midterms.
Houthi military source tells Tasnim that Saudi Aramco facilities are within direct firing range, a fresh threat amid Saudi-Houthi fighting.

dayNote.title: Today's key developments
lines: Ukrainian drones reportedly struck Russia's Afipsky refinery in Krasnodar Krai, with fires reported, while Saudi Aramco cut its December Arab Light price to Asia to a $7 discount.
Overnight, Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed a drone strike on King Fahd Airport in Dammam, and Saudi Civil Defense issued another Sharurah early-warning.
